official_questions.stem:
Consider the following statements with reference to G20 summit :
I. The two-day G20 summit was held in Bali, Indonesia in 2022.
II. “Recover Together, Recover Stronger” is the theme for India’s G20 presidency.
III. “One Earth, One Family, One Future” is the theme for Indonesia’s G20 presidency.
IV. “Data for Development” will be the integral part of overall theme of India’s G20 presidency.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
official_questions.core_fact: G20 2022 summit: Bali, Indonesia (15-16 Nov), theme 'Recover Together, Recover Stronger'; India's presidency (Dec 2022-Nov 2023): 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam - One Earth, One Family, One Future', with 'Data for Development' integral.

statements.t: The two-day G20 summit was held in Bali, Indonesia in 2022.
'Recover Together, Recover Stronger' is the theme for India's G20 presidency.
statements.fact: 'Recover Together, Recover Stronger' was Indonesia's (2022) theme.

statements.t: 'One Earth, One Family, One Future' is the theme for Indonesia's G20 presidency.
statements.fact: 'One Earth, One Family, One Future' was India's (2023) theme.

statements.t: 'Data for Development' will be the integral part of the overall theme of India's G20 presidency.

official_questions.rule: G20 themes: Indonesia 2022 'Recover Together...'; India 2023 'One Earth...'; Brazil 2024 'Building a Just World and a Sustainable Planet' - watch swaps between consecutive hosts.

official_questions.stem:
Consider the following statements with regard to India's Foreign Policy :
I. India's Act East Policy was originally conceived as an economic initiative but had later extended into political, strategic and cultural dimensions.
II. The 'Connect Central Asia Policy' has been taken forward with the institutionalization of the 'India-Central Asia Summit' mechanism.
III. Under the 'Security and Growth for All in the Region' (SAGAR) Policy, the DRDO initiated the Marine and Allied Interdisciplinary Training and Research Initiative (MAITRI) for the purpose of establishing long-term collaboration with countries in the East Asian region.
IV. India's Think West Policy is an outreach to the Western Industrialized nations for strengthening of relations in areas of education and defence.
Which of the above statements are valid ?
official_questions.core_fact: Look East (1991) began as economic; Act East (2014) added strategic, political, cultural dimensions; Connect Central Asia (2012) carried forward by India-Central Asia Summit (Jan 2022); MAITRI is an INCOIS (MoES) training initiative for Indian Ocean countries; Think West = outreach to Gulf/West Asia.

statements.t: Act East was originally an economic initiative later extended to political, strategic and cultural dimensions.
statements.d: originally conceived as an economic initiative

statements.t: Connect Central Asia has been taken forward by the India-Central Asia Summit mechanism.
Under SAGAR, DRDO initiated MAITRI for collaboration with East Asian countries.
statements.fact: MAITRI is by INCOIS (MoES) for Indian Ocean region countries, not DRDO for East Asia.

statements.t: Think West is outreach to Western industrialised nations in education and defence.
statements.fact: Think West concerns West Asia/Gulf, not Western industrialised nations.

official_questions.rule: Look/Act East (SE/E Asia), Think/Link West (Gulf), Connect Central Asia (2012), SAGAR (2015) -> MAHASAGAR (2025).

official_questions.stem:
Which of the following statement/statements can best describe the nature of security concerns/developments for India ?
I. The development of the Hambantota Development Zone can be seen or viewed as a policy of containment funded by Pakistan.
II. India's support in building the Chabahar port in Iran may serve as a strategic act to balance the Chinese-funded Gwadar port in Yemen.
III. Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) is an extension of the Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (ESCAP) and serves as a platform for maritime security.
IV. The Malabar Exercise is connected with the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue (QSD).
Select the correct answer using the codes given below :
official_questions.core_fact: Hambantota (Sri Lanka) was built with Chinese loans (leased to China 2017); Gwadar is in Pakistan (Balochistan); IORA (1997) is an independent regional body; Malabar (India-US, now with Japan and Australia since 2020) brings together all Quad members.

statements.t: Hambantota Development Zone is a containment policy funded by Pakistan.
statements.fact: Hambantota was funded by China, not Pakistan.

statements.t: Chabahar may balance the Chinese-funded Gwadar port in Yemen.
statements.fact: Gwadar is in Pakistan, not Yemen.

statements.t: IORA is an extension of ESCAP and a platform for maritime security.
statements.fact: IORA is an independent organisation (1997), not an extension of ESCAP.

statements.t: The Malabar Exercise is connected with the Quad.

official_questions.rule: Hambantota – China (SL); Gwadar – Pakistan (CPEC); Chabahar – Iran (India); Malabar – Quad navies.
official_questions.key_note: Initial key only. Statement II's core idea (Chabahar balancing Gwadar) is true; only 'Yemen' makes it false.

official_questions.stem:
In the context of Central Government programmes, which one of following statement/statements is/are incorrect ?
I. The objective of Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY) is aimed at reducing poverty of the ST communities by generating additional employment opportunities.
II. Under the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan Yojana (PM-SYM), monthly contribution is payable by the beneficiary, the State Government and the Central Government.
III. Under the 'FutureSkills Prime' Programme, Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) is the key implementing agency.
IV. Mission Karmayogi comprises of eight key pillars that are intended to create functional and behavioural competencies among the civil servants.
Select the answer using the codes given below :
official_questions.core_fact: PM-AJAY (2021-22) is for SC communities; PM-SYM pension: 50:50 by worker and Centre; FutureSkills Prime is a MeitY-NASSCOM programme (C-DAC/NIELIT are resource centres); Mission Karmayogi (NPCSCB) has six pillars.

statements.t: PM-AJAY aims at reducing poverty of ST communities through employment.
statements.fact: PM-AJAY targets Scheduled Castes, not STs.

statements.t: Under PM-SYM the monthly contribution is payable by the beneficiary, the State Government and the Central Government.
statements.fact: PM-SYM is funded 50:50 by worker and Central Government – no State share.

statements.t: C-DAC is the key implementing agency under FutureSkills Prime.
statements.d: C-DAC is the key implementing agency
statements.fact: FutureSkills Prime is implemented by MeitY with NASSCOM.

statements.t: Mission Karmayogi has eight key pillars.
statements.fact: Mission Karmayogi has six pillars.

official_questions.rule: PM-AJAY = SC (Anusuchit Jaati); PM-SYM = Rs 3,000 pension at 60, 50:50; Karmayogi six pillars incl. iGOT.

official_questions.stem:
Which of the following statement/statements is/are valid regarding the National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP) ?
I. NIP includes only economic infrastructure projects but not social infrastructure projects.
II. NIP is aimed to focus on key greenfield projects alone. Brownfield projects are excluded from the NIP's coverage.
III. NIP aims to offer investment opportunities in India's infrastructure sector, and to attract investments into India.
IV. India Investment Grid (IIG) as a platform has ceased to facilitate the NIP and instead 'Invest India' is presently facilitating NIP.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below :
official_questions.core_fact: NIP (Dec 2019, ₹111 lakh cr for FY20-25) covers economic and social infrastructure, greenfield and brownfield projects; projects are showcased on India Investment Grid (IIG).

statements.t: NIP includes only economic infrastructure projects but not social infrastructure projects.
statements.fact: NIP covers both economic and social infrastructure.

statements.t: NIP is aimed to focus on key greenfield projects alone. Brownfield projects are excluded from the NIP's coverage.
statements.fact: NIP covers both greenfield and brownfield projects.

statements.t: NIP aims to offer investment opportunities in India's infrastructure sector, and to attract investments into India.
India Investment Grid (IIG) as a platform has ceased to facilitate the NIP and instead 'Invest India' is presently facilitating NIP.
statements.fact: NIP projects are showcased on the India Investment Grid (run by Invest India).

official_questions.rule: NIP = economic + social, greenfield + brownfield, IIG platform.

official_questions.stem:
Consider the following statements about Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana (PM-MKSSY) :
I. It is a Central Sector Sub-scheme under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada for formalization of the fisheries sector and supporting fisheries micro and small enterprises.
II. It will be implemented with an investment of over ₹ 6,000 crores over a period of next 4 years from FY 2023 – 24 to FY 2026 – 27 in all States and Union Territories.
III. It aims to provide one-time incentive to beneficiaries for purchasing aquaculture insurance.
Which of the above statements are correct ?
official_questions.core_fact: PM-MKSSY (Cabinet, 8 Feb 2024): Central Sector sub-scheme under PMMSY; outlay ₹6,000 crore over FY 2023-24 to 2026-27 in all States/UTs; formalisation, micro-enterprise support, aquaculture insurance incentive, value-chain efficiency.

statements.t: PM-MKSSY is a Central Sector Sub-scheme under PMMSY for formalisation of the fisheries sector and supporting fisheries micro and small enterprises.
It will be implemented with an investment of over ₹6,000 crore over 4 years from FY 2023-24 to FY 2026-27 in all States and UTs.
It aims to provide a one-time incentive to beneficiaries for purchasing aquaculture insurance.

official_questions.rule: Scheme items: check type (central sector vs CSS), outlay, period and components.

official_questions.stem:
Consider the following statements regarding DOSTI drill :
I. DOSTI-16 is a trilateral coast guard exercise between India, Sri Lanka and Maldives conducted from 22 to 25 February, 2024.
II. The DOSTI drill was started in 1991 as a bilateral exercise by the coast guards of India and Sri Lanka.
III. Indian Coast Guard Ship Samarth and ICGS Abhinav participated in the Exercise DOSTI-16.
Which among the above statements are correct ?
official_questions.core_fact: DOSTI: coast-guard exercise begun in 1991 as India-Maldives bilateral; Sri Lanka joined 2012; DOSTI-16 at Male, 22-25 Feb 2024 with ICGS Samarth and ICGS Abhinav (Bangladesh observer).

statements.t: DOSTI-16 is a trilateral coast guard exercise between India, Sri Lanka and Maldives conducted from 22 to 25 February 2024.
The DOSTI drill was started in 1991 as a bilateral exercise by the coast guards of India and Sri Lanka.
statements.fact: DOSTI began in 1991 as an India-Maldives exercise; Sri Lanka joined in 2012.

statements.t: ICGS Samarth and ICGS Abhinav participated in DOSTI-16.

official_questions.rule: Exercises that grew from bilateral to trilateral: identify the founding pair (DOSTI = India-Maldives 1991, Sri Lanka 2012).
